'''February 2001 Melbourne tournament (18 February)''' was a Star Wars CCG open held in Australia on Collins, Melbourne, Australia on 18 February 2001. [[Luca Costanzo]] won it. It is known from Ronnie Wilcox's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1763">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-23-bastardized-melb-aus-18-2-01d1763/ bastardized-melb-aus-18-2-01], DeckTech (Ronnie "AD-fig" Wilcox, 23 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-23-bastardized-melb-aus-18-2-01d1763/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 18 February 2001
* '''Site:''' Australia on Collins, Melbourne, Australia
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Luca Costanzo]]

Players' own reports from this event.

* [[Luca Costanzo Melbourne Australia 18-02-01 (tournament report)]] — by [[Luca Costanzo]], 1st, 4–0

== Discrepancies ==

Where a source disagrees with the record on this page, the page keeps the record and notes the difference here.

* Wilcox gives his round-1 loss to Luca Costanzo as 27; Costanzo's report gives the same game as a win by 29.<ref name="tr-d1763" />
* Costanzo gives his round-1 win over Ronnie Wilcox as +29; Wilcox's report gives the same game as a loss by 27.<ref name="tr-d1780" />
